description.value:
Requirement bio-attuned

Duration constant

It takes more than usual to actually finish you.

You gain an additional round before your first stabilization check when dying, on top of Overgrown Load's own extra round, and you gain this benefit starting at Straining Load rather than waiting for Overgrown.

cinderfall.incomplete: BAND-GAP (and the "extra dying round" it extends -- Overgrown Load's own grant -- isn't itself modeled, so there's nothing to move earlier).
